title: Expiry of the Draw Period on Summit Line Plans
content:
The draw period of a Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage line plan lasts the plan's draw period, in calendar months, from the closing date; the borrower is reminded the plan's notice period, in calendar days, before it ends.

## The rule

- The draw period ends only on or after the date that is the plan's draw period in calendar months after the loan closing.
- That date is the same day number in the month that many calendar months after the closing date, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist, and the period ends on that date itself.
- When it ends, the whole undrawn line is cancelled on that date, and the loan continues to accrue interest until it is repaid. The loan's status becomes draw period expired.

The clock runs from the closing date on the loan record for that loan.

## Fixing the end date

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Starting point | the closing date on the loan record |
| Length | the plan's draw period, counted in calendar months |
| End date | the same day number in the month reached, or that month's last day where the day number does not exist |
| The end date itself | the period ends on it; the end is reached on that date and on any later date, never before |
| On the end date | the whole undrawn line is cancelled |
| After the end | interest continues to accrue until repayment; no line remains to draw |

## Date cases (hypothetical closings)

- **A 60-month draw period, closing on the 14th of a month.** The end date is the 14th of the same calendar month five years later. On the 13th of that month the period has not ended; on the 14th it ends, and the undrawn line is cancelled that day.
- **A 120-month draw period, closing on 29 February of a leap year.** The month reached is February ten years later, which in a non-leap year has no 29th; the end date falls back to 28 February, and the period ends on that date.
- **A 120-month draw period, closing on 31 January.** The month reached is January ten years later, which has a 31st; the end date is 31 January.
